extraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. The input is the exact edit target, a historical manuscript scan. Isolate only the specified original painted subject on a truly transparent background, including transparency in every genuine gap. Preserve the source's exact pose, proportions, distinctive anatomy, count, contours, fine original black outlines, pale painted foreground, coloring and aged brushwork. Follow actual drawn boundaries with clean antialiasing. Remove paper, page tint, reverse-page ghosts, text, ruler lines, neighboring ornament and unrelated marks. Do not invent concealed parts, change anatomy, thicken or simplify the drawing, add a border/shadow, or modernize it. This is conservation extraction, not a redesign. Subject: only this complete crouching ape facing right and extending both hands together. Keep its precise bent knees, feet, finger outlines and original little ear and snout. The red-and-blue ornamental border touching the bottom and left of the feet is unrelated and must be excluded. Do not add a tail or redraw the gesture. Retain only actually visible original anatomy.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.
extraction.subject_resolution_cap_method: Both subject axes capped to inspected native subject bounds; input-region whitespace cannot permit subject upscaling.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

review.notes: Replaced old resized binary selection. Complete original crouching pose, reaching hands, fingers and folded feet checked against source; unrelated border removed. Clean antialiasing and opaque pale painted body; AI cleanup changes scan texture and removes photo color cast.

previous_review.notes: Source and original selected pixels compared: full visible hands, feet, mitre and shared staff retained. Separate crouching ape is disconnected; bird talons and staff-holding ape remain together. Parent RGBA pixels unchanged.

archived_source_layout.reason: Crouching ape is independent; owl gripping the ape-held staff is retained as one interacting pair. Combined disconnected layout omitted by user grouping rule.

extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the original supplied native manuscript region. Extract the entire standing blue/gray-robed man, the actual long-tailed bird he holds in his hands, and the original gray/blue foliate support that touches his boots, including both orange leaves and the curled lower gray leaf. These form a single contacting group. Preserve every original feather, complete source-visible boot and support contour, fine stems, gold garment patch, orange head and pale gray painted fold. The bird is not hooded. Remove the exterior parchment, nearby writing and unrelated flat gold page field; all real gaps between figure, bird, limbs and the support must be transparent. Preserve native proportions and hand-painted details exactly; no redraw, new support, invented toes or missing anatomy. Transparent background with natural antialiased edges.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Inspected native original, white/dark whole figure, native head/hand/bird and both boots/leaf openings/lower support. All contacting parts remain one group. Original pale robes and flesh, gilded collar and held bird are opaque; the true openings between legs and foliate branches are clear. Original scan expanded through the complete blue curled support and orange terminal flower at the separate gilt margin-bar junction. The cropped original right robe edge is recorded honestly; black photographed book removed. Source scale/RGB retained; no completed anatomy, generic redraw or polygon edge.

assets.usage_notes: The man, held bird and vine beneath his feet form one contacting group. The complete blue support and orange terminal flower are included; the separate gilt page-margin bar is excluded at their original junction.
